name: diamond-report-unit-tests
description: Unit tests for the scoring/formula functions scripts/update-tracker.mjs exports -- the server-side model that actually selects and grades real HR Threats/K Props/Diamond Report picks (as opposed to tests/visual, which covers on-page rendering). Zero dependencies: uses Node's built-in node:test runner, same 'no root package.json/node_modules' reasoning as the rest of the repo (see .github/workflows/build-assets.yml and tests/visual/package.json) -- there's simply nothing to install.
